question: population loss from a nuclear strike
rule: killed = the number of the city's citizens working tiles inside the blast radius (the free city-centre tile does NOT count); if that number is the city's whole POPULATION the strike kills NOBODY
gate: killed >= pop -> 0 killed (skipped whole, no floor-to-1); the comparison is against the POPULATION, so a citizen on no tile - a specialist or an unemployed one - voids the pass for every tile-worker
tick: the strike tick; nothing further is lost on the next three turns
reassignment: a citizen already standing on contaminated ground is never moved; seats freed by a kill ARE refilled at once

note: gate: every citizen inside, so none die - the owner's own 4->4 reading reproduced
a NEIGHBOUR city loses the citizen working 37:21, a tile inside the blast; its own centre was never hit
the incomplete AQUEDUCT district was REMOVED by the blast (districtsTotal 3 -> 2)
killed = pop-1 is allowed, so the gate is 'would empty the city', not 'would leave fewer than two'
gate - lab2's 'refutation' of the wiki was this case
the SMALLER bomb kills where the larger one killed nobody
the city that survived two thermonuclear strikes loses 3 of 4 to a radius-1 device

THE DECIDER. A city founded at 32:16 for this scene owns only its centre and ring 1, so its 5 tile-workers are all inside the blast and ChangePopulation(+9) left 5 citizens on no tile. Every worked tile covered and it still lost 5 - the gate is compared to the POPULATION. The 5 survivors then took the 5 contaminated tiles at once
the same city, the same weapon, the same aim plot, seconds later: with no idle citizen the pass fires and it loses nothing

result: no delayed loss anywhere; every struck city GREW on the next turn (NIDAROS 3->4, TOKYO 1->2->3, OKAYAMA 2->3->4, SENDAI 2->3->4, MUSCAT 6->7), so the kill is a one-tick ChangePopulation and the food box is not touched

question: can a city shrug off a thermonuclear blast population-wise by seating every citizen in rings 0-2
why: a radius-2 blast covers 1+6+12 tiles and the centre is auto-worked by nobody, so it shelters no citizen; each district or unworkable tile inside rings 1-2 lowers the ceiling by one
condition: ALL-or-nothing: one specialist or unemployed citizen and every covered tile-worker dies instead
protects: population only - districts, buildings and improvements are still pillaged, all 19 tiles contaminated for 20 turns, every unit killed, unfinished districts destroyed, the centre's HP floored
counters: aim one ring off the city centre
use the radius-1 device: rings 0-1 only, so a city of more than about 6 keeps workers outside the blast and the pass never fires (rows 8-13)

finding: returns FALSE for every plot on the whole map from the tuner; a city was then founded without complaint on a plot it called invalid. Use UnitManager.CanStartOperation(settler, UnitOperationTypes.FOUND_CITY, nil, {PARAM_X, PARAM_Y}) instead.
